commands.review_summary:
The PR adds loopback-only OpenAI-compatible local vision classification, endpoint and image-transmission provenance, and revised classification queue terminal/retry behavior while preserving Ollama as the default.

Reproducibility: yes. The exact-head source constructs the image_url data URI reported rejected by LM Studio 0.4.9+1, and it sends HEIC source bytes unchanged despite LM Studio documenting JPEG, PNG, and WebP input support.

target.title: feat: support loopback-only LM Studio vision classification
target.body:
## Summary

Adds OpenAI-compatible local vision classification for LM Studio while keeping
the existing Ollama path as the default.

- Select with `--local-model-api openai`; base URLs such as
  `http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1` normalize to the chat-completions endpoint.
- Require every endpoint hostname resolution to be loopback-only. Revalidate
  redirects and DNS again at dial time; bypass ambient HTTP proxies.
- Persist the requested endpoint, every endpoint that actually responded, HTTP
  request/response counts, loopback scope, and transmitted-image provenance.
- Mark non-image rows terminal for vision classification while leaving remote
  images retryable.
- Prioritize new pending rows before retryable metadata-classified rows.

`export` is intentionally not part of this PR. It needs a separate product
proposal and real Apple Photos proof.

## Verification

Exact head: `7a119845935e73801a919314c68837b7703601f9`

Full local gate:

```sh
GOWORK=off go mod verify
GOWORK=off go mod tidy -diff
GOWORK=off go vet ./...
GOWORK=off go run golang.org/x/tools/cmd/deadcode@v0.45.0 -test ./...
GOWORK=off go test -count=1 ./...
GOWORK=off go build -trimpath -o /private/tmp/photoscrawl-pr3 ./cmd/photoscrawl
```

Results: module verification clean; tidy diff empty; vet clean; deadcode empty;
all packages passed; built binary SHA-256
`aa0de3ab3c7434805df573c188752472a3a091e016e154907748d1b680598295`.

Real-binary behavior proof used a synthetic SQLite archive and a loopback
OpenAI-compatible HTTP stub:

- Valid loopback redirect: one asset and three content observations, zero
  failures. The CLI and SQLite model-run metadata recorded both responding
  endpoints and two HTTP requests/two responses. Per-asset evidence recorded
  the final endpoint and 24 transmitted fixture bytes.
- Direct `192.0.2.10` endpoint: exit 1 with loopback-only rejection.
- Loopback redirect to `192.0.2.10`: one terminal content failure; only the
  loopback redirect endpoint appeared in provenance, with one request/response.
  The stub's final-response count did not increase.
- Remote-only video: first run stored `content_unavailable` with zero waiting;
  second run processed zero rows and made no model request.
- `photoscrawl export`: exit 2; top-level usage contains no export command.

Behavior-validator contract: 6 pass, 0 fail, 0 blocked. Final AutoReview:
clean, no accepted/actionable findings.

Hosted CI `CI/test` passed on the exact head:
https://github.com/openclaw/photoscrawl/actions/runs/29556214804

Thanks @mbelinky for the original LM Studio/OpenAI-compatible classifier work.
